title: RCMWE Movie Fellowship
summary: On the auspicious occasion of Diwali, the club embraced the festive spirit by organising a special movie outing to watch Ramayana.
description:
On the auspicious occasion of Diwali, the club embraced the festive spirit by organising a special movie outing to watch Ramayana. The event brought together 25 enthusiastic members, who enjoyed a wonderful cinematic experience filled with joy, togetherness, and festive cheer.

Beyond the movie, the outing provided a delightful opportunity for members to bond, share laughter, strengthen friendships, and create cherished memories. The warmth, camaraderie, and lively interactions made the gathering truly memorable.

It was a beautiful celebration of the spirit of Diwali, reflecting the essence of fellowship, unity, and togetherness that makes our club so special.
